items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: I played with him... I do remember that Edwin Washington... Oh yeah, he was there.

ctx.x: Well you did play with him? Yeah I played with him, I stayed with him about three years. Oh you did, I see. Then I went with Buddy. Well can you remember any of the other boys that were in Jewel Barnes' band at that time?
Well, most of them now is dead, but I do remember that Edwin Washington, you know Washington. Oh yeah, he was there. Big Washington. Big Washington. Yeah, Big Washington.
